metadata.notes: Frank Energie offers two dynamic tariff options: one without solar panels support (with negative feed-in compensation), and one with solar panels support (with matching buy/sell rates).
metadata.margin_notes: These are the tariff rates/margins from Frank Energie. To get total consumer cost, combine with ENTSOE market prices and applicable taxes.
